dmn-modeler.js is a combined, pre-built bundle (global: window.AtlasDmn) of:

  - pblumer/dmn-js@17.10.2
    commit: 43a65632c4133e101be1ce670225a2850aa35e72
  - pblumer/dmn-moddle
    commit: 23697fac646aaa0bc09d9ce3ae90c96769397bc6
  - dmn-js-properties-panel@3.11.1
  - @bpmn-io/properties-panel@3.48.0
  - camunda-dmn-moddle@1.3.1    (the camunda: DMN moddle descriptor, for versionTag et al.)
  - esbuild@0.25.9              (bundler only; not shipped)

The dmn-js fork is pinned to the exact commit above. Its dmn-js-shared package
pins dmn-moddle to the exact commit above as well. The fork adds generic DMN 1.5
Decision Service authoring, divider modeling and editing, semantic roundtrip
support, importing a Decision Service as a container so the box is drawn beneath
what it holds and carries its members when moved, laying one out — moving it on
the canvas without its memberships being re-decided behind the modeler's back —
and wiring one up, since a Decision Service is an Invocable and a Decision
invokes it through a Knowledge Requirement (DMN 1.5 Table 2). It also draws the
DRD the way DMN draws it: Input Data as a stadium at any height, a Decision
Service as a rounded rectangle with a heavy border and its name in the top
right, a collapsed service marked as collapsed, and every element under the text
its DMNDI label gives it rather than its own name. The fork holds all of that
against a notation table of its own, one row per element and per requirement,
read off the drawn geometry. No Atlas-specific behavior is implemented inside
dmn-js or dmn-moddle.

All bpmn.io / MIT (see LICENSE). The properties panel and the Modeler must share
ONE dmn-js instance, so they are bundled together. The build is done offline and
only its OUTPUT is committed; nothing is built during Atlas's own build/CI
(ADR-0012/0062: no CDN, no build step at runtime).

window.AtlasDmn exposes: DmnJS (the Modeler), DmnPropertiesPanelModule,
DmnPropertiesProviderModule, CamundaPropertiesProviderModule, CamundaModdleDescriptor.

Do not edit dmn-modeler.js by hand. src/ holds the build inputs:

  - src/index.js            the bundle entry point
  - src/package.json        the third-party dependencies, pinned exactly
  - src/package-lock.json   their resolved tree

To rebuild, with Node 24 and ATLAS=this repository, FORK=a checkout of
pblumer/dmn-js at the commit above:

  cd $FORK && npm ci && npm run build-distro
  WORK=$(mktemp -d)
  cp $ATLAS/api/web/vendor/dmn/src/package*.json $WORK/
  cd $WORK && npm ci --legacy-peer-deps
  cp -rn $WORK/node_modules/. $FORK/node_modules/
  mkdir -p $FORK/src && cp $ATLAS/api/web/vendor/dmn/src/index.js $FORK/src/
  cd $FORK && ./node_modules/.bin/esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife \
    --global-name=AtlasDmn --loader:.json=json --minify --legal-comments=none \
    --outfile=$ATLAS/api/web/vendor/dmn/dmn-modeler.js
  cp -r $FORK/packages/dmn-js/dist/assets/. $ATLAS/api/web/vendor/dmn/assets/

Two details of that recipe are load-bearing:

  - The bundle is built FROM INSIDE the fork checkout so that dmn-js and its
    sibling packages resolve to the fork's workspaces. Building from a directory
    with its own node_modules pulls the PUBLISHED dmn-js instead and silently
    drops every DMN 1.5 feature.
  - `--legacy-peer-deps` keeps npm from installing dmn-js as a peer of
    dmn-js-properties-panel, and `cp -rn` does not clobber, so packages the fork
    already provides win. Shared libraries such as diagram-js therefore end up in
    the bundle exactly once, as they must.

Reproducibility: the tree is determined by the fork commit (via the fork's own
lockfile) together with src/package-lock.json. Before that lockfile existed the
recipe pinned only direct dependencies and used --no-package-lock, so bundles
built at different times differ by whatever the transitive tree had drifted to;
the bundle committed before this one is not reproducible for that reason.

assets/ holds the dmn-js diagram/drd/decision-table/literal-expression CSS and
icon font from the pinned fork distro, plus properties-panel.css from
@bpmn-io/properties-panel@3.48.0.
